channel.ntfy.desc: Send plain-text messages to an ntfy topic over HTTP
channel.ntfy.field.url.desc: Full topic address, for example https://ntfy.example.com/topic; the last path segment is the topic
channel.ntfy.field.token.desc: Bearer token sent as an Authorization header; omitted when it renders empty
channel.ntfy.field.priority.desc: Message priority, 1 to 5 or min, low, default, high, max; sent as a Priority header only when set
channel.ntfy.field.tags.desc: Tags sent as a Tags header, given as a list or a comma-separated string
channel.ntfy.error.missing_url: url is required and has to point at a topic
channel.ntfy.error.invalid_url: {{.URL}} is not a valid ntfy address
channel.ntfy.error.missing_topic: the url has no topic, which is the last path segment
channel.ntfy.error.empty_content: title and body are both empty
channel.ntfy.error.invalid_priority: {{.Value}} is not a valid priority, want 1 to 5 or min, low, default, high, max
channel.ntfy.error.invalid_header: the value of the {{.Name}} header holds a control character
channel.ntfy.error.http_status: the ntfy server answered with status {{.Status}}: {{.Body}}
channel.ntfy.warn.truncated: message body was cut at the {{.Limit}} byte limit
